<!--
HOW TO ADD A NEW PLAYLIST SECTION:

1. Copy the whole ::: {.yt-section} ... ::: block above (from "## All Videos" down
   to the closing ":::" after the grid).
2. Paste it below this comment.
3. Change "## All Videos" to your playlist name, e.g. "## Hypothesis Testing Series".
4. For each video, duplicate one <div class="yt-card">...</div> block and change:
   - the video ID in onclick="ytPlay(this, 'VIDEO_ID')"
   - the video ID in the thumbnail src URL (the same ID, twice)
   - the alt text and the text inside <p class="yt-title">...</p>
-->

```{=html}
<script>
function ytPlay(card, videoId) {
  const wrap = card.querySelector('.yt-thumb-wrap');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + videoId +
    '?autoplay=1" title="YouTube video" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media" allowfullscreen></iframe>';
}
</script>
```
